question.html:
A curling stone of mass 17 kg travelling at 2.5 cm s−1 collides with a second stationary curling stone of mass 19 kg. The second curling stone is scattered with a speed of 0.50 cm s−1 at an angle of 30° to the initial direction of the first stone.

a.i Calculate the component of momentum of the first curling stone perpendicular to the initial direction. [1]

a.ii Calculate the velocity component of the first curling stone in the initial direction. [2]

a.iii Determine the velocity of the first curling stone. [2]

b Deduce whether this collision is elastic. [2]
